outcome: Effects of COVID-19 on pregnancy and neonates
Mode of delivery for mothers with COVID-19
finding: This review article summarizes the clinical manifestations and effects of COVID-19 in pregnancy and newborns, and discusses preventive measures, treatment options, delivery plans, and breastfeeding recommendations for infected mothers.
mod_finding: Coronavirus itself is not an indication for cesarean delivery; the mode of delivery should be determined on a case-by-case basis.
